candidates.reason: Primary tests that wait on the engine slot heartbeat: TestMain::test_sleep relies on repeated heartbeat calls while the start() generator is paused (four 2-second sleeps against the 5-second production interval), and TestRequestSendOrder::test_lazy waits for signals.scheduler_empty emitted from the heartbeat-scheduled retry. These are the tests expected to become fast once the heartbeat is shortened/stubbed for tests.

Shared test-helper module: OneShotLoop/TwoShotLoop stub the looping calls that back the engine heartbeat, and get_script_run_env builds the environment used for subprocess tests that coverage instruments on PyPy. Any heartbeat test helper or subprocess-env tweak from this change is expected to land here.

Already monkeypatches scrapy.core.engine.create_looping_call with the looping-call stubs to avoid a background heartbeat, so it shares the mechanism this change reuses or refactors for the engine heartbeat.

Spawns the crawler in subprocesses with a timeout explicitly sized because starting scripts is slow on PyPy with coverage measurement on; verifies the effect of disabling subprocess coverage in the PyPy environments.

Interactive-shell tests spawn subprocesses and document that interpreter start-up on PyPy with coverage enabled takes well over 10 seconds, so they are a direct measure of the PyPy job slowdown this change removes.
